text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A photoshoot was underway for a magazine 
feature on the racing silks tailored by 
Beauty Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! This outfit really is great! Right 
now, I feel like I could cast some 
incredible magic♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. You look so much more 
mature. Doesn't that mean you're growing 
into a splendid witch?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"A witch...!? Really!? You really think 
so!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There are no lies in the words of a 
first-class lady♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'd expect nothing less from you two to 
notice the goal behind this outfit! Growth 
in attire means growth in spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Break time at last!! I'm so totally 
starving!! You're coming to lunch too, 
right, King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pass. I wouldn't want to get my 
outfit dirty."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrooooowl~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what a loud sound! What's with 
that, King? You're starving too, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Maybe I cut back on food a bit too 
much for the shoot...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're doing that!? You have to eat 
properly, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! If you're worried about 
getting dirty, just use magic that keeps 
it from getting dirty!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Magic that keeps dirt away...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It bounces off all the dirt! Just like 
King said, I've grown as a witch, so a 
little spell like this is a piece of 
cake!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle☆ Dirt, begone! ...All 
right, that should do it♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, with th-this, we can rest easy. 
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Today's special is katsu curry udon! Hey, 
hey, let's get that!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of all things!?
choice_data_list:
...M-Maybe something like a sandwich would 
be better...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I cast a spell earlier, so it'll be fine! 
Come on, let's place our order!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was being pretty careful while 
eating, but...
choice_data_list:
It's not very noticeable, but there's some 
broth splashed on you...

It's not very noticeable, but there's some 
broth splashed on you...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
When they take a close-up shot... it makes 
me feel a bi~t self-conscious...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy?! I put up a barrier! I cast a 
spell and everything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Waaah! Why isn't my magic working?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! Why does it always end up like 
thiiiis?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And here I thought I'd finally 
become a full-fledged, splendid witch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking about how to comfort her 
as she cried over her magic not working, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *waaah*...!! King... I'm so 
sorrrryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh dear? Did you spill food on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“If it's just that much, it should come 
right off if you wipe it with a wet towel, 
you know?”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar! Lend me a towel, a wet one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Beauty Anshinzawa said, pressing a 
towel against it removed the stain easily.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding me~~~?! How was it that 
easy...!!
choice_data_list: So the barrier spell was working!

Is this a new kind of magic that cleans 
off dirt?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!! R-Right, of course!! Definitely, it 
must be!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, I really am growing as a proper 
witch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't I tell you? A first-rate lady's 
words are never false. Ohohoho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's Racewear, so the fabric is likely 
stain-resistant. However, everyone 
collectively kept quiet about that."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Really?! ...Wait, but I didn't even chant 
a spell!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, for someone who has grown as a 
witch like you, cleaning off dirt with 
overflowing magical power should be a 
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Exactly! I'm Sweepy, after all. 
Being able to do this much is only 
natural!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the material was designed so 
stains would easily wash out anyway, but 
seeing her genuine delight, I decided not 
to mention it.
